strings.en: I'm the one who's going to survive!
All right, I can lock on!
I knew going in this would be reckless!
Here it comes! It's up to you, Hugo!
I've sent you the enemy's pattern data!
You're not getting away that easily!
Persistent types have never brought me/　anything good...!
Al-Van, I won't let you have your way!
Don't think you can take this, Al-Van!
I'll tear into you first, Karo-Ran!
Perish along with your ambitions, Gu-Landon!
I'll defeat you and end this war with the Fury!
You've played with fire long enough, Gomoudokka!
Reggiane, I won't let your kind have their way!
You won't get the Cross Gate, Herluga!
Judging him by his looks would be dangerous...!
Debudedabide, I've no intention of playing/　along with your street act!
No life signs. Destroying the unit!
So now it's a puppet inside and out!
Don't think those fangs can crush me!
Bones should stay sleeping under the earth!
XN-L! Humanity isn't so weak/　that you can wipe us out!
Popping out of nowhere and spouting/　such nonsense!
XN-L... You've bared your fangs/　at the wrong opponent!
I'm used to fighting that bunch!
I know exactly what you've got!
Come to the Earth Sphere all you want!
Golaikunru, I won't let you have your way!
I'll drive the Golaikunru out of Earth's sphere!
As long as they're around, the war with/　the Zovorg won't end!
High-performance or not, I know its tricks!
Get in close, and even an Org-Valu...!
Hit the mothership, and they'll slow down!
I can handle even a new model's motions!
Leave that Thick Cylinder to me!
You can never be too careful with a Thorn...!
Are you saying it's a ghost...?
Whatever we're facing, protecting the city/　comes first!
I'll clean up every last Lamaris!
We can't leave the Lamaris running loose!
Even if it's a Kaana type!
I'll take down the Lamaris Kaana in one go!
So they can grow even bigger...!
Ares Geist... The one inside it is...!
I'll go along with Lieutenant Arieil's gamble...!
I'll knock it out of that position!
I won't let this chance slip away!
I won't let it end like this!
I'll pay you back in kind!
Damn it! Is this the end?!
Ugh! I can't drop out here!
Like hell I'll back down! I'm pressing on!
Damn, even the frame's taken damage!!
I've made it through hell like this/　plenty of times!
As long as the Booster's alive,/　I can stay on him!
Ngh...! Not bad...!/　But you didn't finish the job!
I've been through hell like this/　plenty of times before!
I have no intention of choosing/　this place to die!
Gah...!/　Cerberus, don't go down yet!!
Ugh...! S-So this is the moment of truth!
If it's come to this,/　I'm with you all the way!
I-Is it time to brace for the worst...?!
Not yet! Don't you dare give up!
T-To do this much damage/　to the Garmraid...!!
Jua-Mu! This fight isn't over yet!
There must still be a way/　to break down the Raftclans!
If I don't stop Gu-Landon here,/　Earth and the Fury will...!
So he's confident enough/　to show himself...!
Reggiane, I won't let you go any further!
I can't let him use the Cross Gate/　any more than he already has...!
I can't read the Crystal Dragoon's moves!
If you can't even take my one life,/　how could you destroy all of humanity...?!
Ugh! Falling behind a Zovorg machine...!
Ngh, I took the Ida's full power...!
As long as the unit moves, I can manage!
The servos aren't shot!/　I can still go!
I can still recover! This is where it starts!
Tch! He's a cut above me!
I can still win! I won't give up!
It's too early to get cocky!
I can still win...! I won't give up!
The frame's undamaged! I can still go!
I won't let you take the momentum!
A direct hit on the Cerberus... Not bad!
Now we're paying them back double!!
Hang on,/　I'll send you the prediction data now!
As long as the unit moves, we can manage!/　No, I'll make sure we do!
W-Well, the damage isn't/　as bad as I thought...!
Check it again, just to be sure.
Tch, I fell right into that one!
Stay alert! Another one may be coming!
Sorry, that was careless of me...!
Never mind. Think about what's next.
Ngh! Aqua, how's the TE Engine's output?!
I shouldn't rely too much/　on the Garmraid's armor...!
I won't let Jua-Mu get carried away!
Damn Al-Van, his attacks are heavy as ever!
Ngh! Faster than the other Raftclans!
So it's different from a regular Raftclans...!
Enjoy it while it lasts,/　Gomoudokka!
I can't just let Vort keep pushing me around...!
That woman has the skill to back up her bark...!
I have to pull him away/　from the Cross Gate, fast...!
Looks like he's not all show...!
I don't intend to be eaten by a dragon!
Ngh, light on its feet because it's all bones...?!
Ugh! I won't yield to XN-L!
These Lamaris are a pain when they swarm...!
If something that big multiplies,/　we won't be able to stop it!
That's not even enough to hold me back!
Don't think that'll be enough to stop me!
I'll need an RT arrangement/　of my evasion motions...!
Tch, it's latched onto the Cerberus!
The chest's front armor.../　But we can still fight!
Ngh! Well done landing a hit on us!
You'll pay for this later, you know?
Aqua, have you analyzed that attack pattern?
All done! The same trick won't work again!
As expected of the Garmraid... It's tough.
You're no match for me, So-Des!
Damn Al-Van, he's read my moves!
Karo-Ran... Is he trying to hold me in check...?
You call yourself an emperor with that, Gu-Landon?!
Tch! So his goal is to pin me down...!
You don't know your merchandise's specs very well!
Ngh, I can't waste time on that woman!
Even with the Cross Gate, that's all you've got,/　Herluga?!
Skull Knight, no need to hold back!
A few hits don't matter!/　I'm taking down XN-L here!
So they know our specs too...!
That's a thick barrage, all right!
I couldn't shake off the Lamaris Kaana...!
Looks like your aim was off!
Like you could pin down the Cerberus!
I knew you'd come at me like that!
Such monotonous attacks.../　I don't even need to predict them!
Like you could keep up with us!
We did it, just as predicted.
Even the Garmraid can manage this much!
Looks like you underestimated/　the Garmraid's mobility...!
Things won't go as you planned, Gomoudokka!
I won't be fooled by your illusions!
Not by some Zovorg small fry!
All right, let's keep luring them in!
If you think speed alone can toy with me,/　you're dead wrong!
I won't be beaten by a ghost!
I've no intention of playing with Lamaris!
So what if the Lamaris combined!
I've no intention of being monster food!
Like I'd lose to a Yokijin!
For this, a standard/　evasion pattern will do.
Looks like the evasion pattern arrangement worked.
...Wasn't the deployment a bit slow/　just now?
Wh-What are you talking about!?/　Come on, hurry up and counter!
That kind of attack is useless!
I can pull off tricks like this, too!
Calm down! I'll think of something!
It failed to break away...! Now!
You left an opening...! Here I come!!
Moving in to support! Clear the way!
To think I'd end up/　supporting the Granzon...!
Moving to cover the Red Ogre!
Major, I'll take it from here!
Lieutenant Lamia, I'll back you up!
Arado, leave the rest to me!
Josh, leave the rest to me!
Rim, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Kyosuke, leave the rest to me!
All right, support the ATX Team!
SRX Team! I'll back you up!
Lieutenant Calvina, I'll back you up!
I've got your back, Mustache Man!
Leave this to us and fall back!
I can at least do this much!
Don't worry about it!/　I don't go down that easily!
Let's take them all at once!!
I'll keep pressing until you're cornered!
Hugo, we can still do this!
Let's finish this in one go!
